'''Leina''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]. During [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]], she was friends with [[Shreya Ordassa]]. After Ordassa left [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], the two did not see one another for some time. When Ordassa, now an esteemed professor, traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], with the intent to bid on the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], Leina visited the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] as well. During the vacation, Leina was a regular customer of the [[Three Beldons Buffet]]. She could also be found at the [[Pair O'Dice/Legends|Pair O'Dice]] casino in the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]] hotel.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

Because of their time apart, Leina was considerably less loyal, prioritizing her entertainment as much as catching up with or comforting Ordassa. [[Mil Mikkir]], Ordassa's ex-boyfriend, flirted with Leina and quickly invited her to dance.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />
